definition.latent: origin misstated period overlapped the director's origin seat, ended before the tie, and was first restated after the tie; no origin filing within the 5 years before the tie (so no recent public label); variants: filing >= 183 days after the tie, no origin filing ever before the tie
definition.revealed: exposed_served (seat overlapped a misstated period of a restatement filed before the tie)
definition.label_only: origin filed within 5 years before the tie but the director joined the origin after every such misstated period ended
definition.present_at_filing_only: seat covered a filing date before the tie but overlapped no misstated period
definition.clean: no origin filing before the tie and not latent

C_frozen_network_event_study.presence_note: linked destinations and controls both require a feed event at or before the freeze (f-12m) and one at or after it; no condition on events after the filing (before 2026-10-12 controls alone were required to record an event at or after f+12m)

matching.cells: restatement filed within 3 years before the freeze x filed earlier than that (4 cells); 3 controls per linked destination

drift_bounds_recent_onset.headline_adjustment: formation-year and formation-year x post effects (did_yfe)
drift_bounds_recent_onset.note: identified set = cohort-adjusted headline change +/- (M x largest cohort-adjusted pre-period year-to-year change + appointment-date jump b); a differential drift equal to the estimate would be needed for the true effect to be zero, and a drift of (estimate - 1) for a one-point effect

row13_recent_onset_plus_prior.partial_R2_method: FWL residual correlation (t-based values kept for comparison)

row16_inbound_recent_onset_plus_prior.partial_R2_method: FWL residual correlation (t-based values kept for comparison)

monotone_selection_bound_recent_onset.adjustment: formation-year effects (level); formation-year x post effects (change)
monotone_selection_bound_recent_onset.assumption: destinations that appoint from recently restating origins have weakly higher latent risk (positive selection on the label); stationary selection across the two windows for the change version

placebo_formation_dates.note: _yfe versions include formation-year and formation-year x post effects, the adjustment used for the headline recent-exposure change

permutation_recent_onset_change.note: exposure labels permuted within formation-year x destination-size-decile cells (feed-age decile where size is missing); statistic = coefficient of recent exposure in a regression of the pair's post-minus-pre onset indicator with cell fixed effects
